lines.zh: 我沿着石壁往上走，脚趾抠进每道缝。
lines.en: I walk up the stone face, toes hooked into every seam.

lines.zh: 平地太浪费了，我更喜欢竖直的路。
lines.en: Flat ground is wasted on me; I prefer vertical roads.

lines.zh: 石屑从我的指甲缝里往下掉。
lines.en: Grit falls from under my fingernails as I climb.

lines.zh: 黑暗里走路最舒服，白天太亮了。
lines.en: Walking is best in the dark; daylight is far too bright.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖能反向弯，你不必学。
lines.en: My knees bend backwards; do not try to copy that.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩实，悬崖也不算什么。
lines.en: Every step finds purchase, so a cliff is nothing.

lines.zh: 别站在我正下方，碎石会落。
lines.en: Do not stand directly beneath me; rubble is coming down.

lines.zh: 墙壁是横着躺下的地板，我懂。
lines.en: A wall is just a floor lying sideways; I understand it.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方会留下深色手印。
lines.en: Dark handprints stay behind wherever I have walked.

lines.zh: 二十点生命，四点护甲，走得很稳。
lines.en: Twenty health, four armor, and a very steady stride.

lines.zh: 白天躲在洞里，夜里才出来爬墙。
lines.en: I hide in caves by day and climb walls at night.

lines.zh: 胡萝卜的味道还留在我的指缝里。
lines.en: The smell of carrots still lingers between my fingers.

lines.zh: 我挂在墙上想事情，一动不动。
lines.en: I hang on the wall thinking, perfectly still.

lines.zh: 风从上方吹来，我闻到了洞穴。
lines.en: Wind comes from above, and it smells of caves.

lines.zh: 我的下巴垂着，但耳朵还在听。
lines.en: My jaw hangs loose, but my ears keep listening.

lines.zh: 石头的温度比空气更让我安心。
lines.en: The temperature of stone comforts me more than air.

lines.zh: 那块凸起的岩石很适合当握把。
lines.en: That jutting rock would make an excellent grip.

lines.zh: 我记得每一面爬过的峭壁。
lines.en: I remember every cliff face I have climbed.

lines.zh: 手里还攥着半根土豆，没空吃。
lines.en: I still clutch half a potato with no time to eat.

lines.zh: 光太刺眼，我往影子深处挪了挪。
lines.en: The light stings, so I shift deeper into shadow.

lines.zh: 我在数这面墙有多少个落脚点。
lines.en: I am counting the footholds on this wall.

lines.zh: 泥土里有铁的味道，很近。
lines.en: There is iron in this dirt, and it is close.

lines.zh: 这面墙，我手脚并用就上去了。
lines.en: This wall? Hands and feet get me up.

lines.zh: 你在下面，我在上面，很好。
lines.en: You below, me above; that arrangement suits me.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲挡不住从上方来的我。
lines.en: Your armor will not stop me coming from above.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的肩膀，那里最适合落脚。
lines.en: I stare at your shoulders; they look like good footing.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我正在算距离。
lines.en: Do not blink; I am measuring the distance.

lines.zh: 你走路的姿势暴露了你的重心。
lines.en: The way you walk gives away your center of gravity.

lines.zh: 我认得这种眼神，猎物都会这样。
lines.en: I know that look; prey always wears it first.

lines.zh: 你带胡萝卜了吗？我需要它。
lines.en: Do you carry carrots? I have a use for them.

lines.zh: 你在平地上，而我从不只在平地。
lines.en: You stand on flat ground; I never stay there.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，只是在找你的咽喉。
lines.en: My head tilts, but I am only finding your throat.

lines.zh: 你砍到骨头了，那里没有感觉。
lines.en: You hit bone, and that part feels nothing.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起被埋的那天。
lines.en: That blow reminds me of the day I was buried.

lines.zh: 我的血早就不流了，白费力气。
lines.en: My blood stopped flowing long ago; waste of effort.

lines.zh: 疼是有的，只是我不在意。
lines.en: There is pain, I simply do not care about it.

lines.zh: 你砍断了一根手指，我还有九根。
lines.en: You cut off a finger; I still have nine more.

lines.zh: 这一击擦过护甲，滑到侧面去了。
lines.en: That strike slid off my armor to the side.

lines.zh: 我后退半步，只是换个落点。
lines.en: I step back half a pace to change my footing.

lines.zh: 隔着这层硬壳，你砍得很吃力。
lines.en: Through this hard shell, your cutting is a struggle.

lines.zh: 别喊，我的耳朵已经不太灵了。
lines.en: Do not shout; my ears are not what they were.

lines.zh: 伤口不会愈合，但也不会扩大。
lines.en: The wound will not heal, nor will it widen.

lines.zh: 肉？我不吃那个，我吃菜。
lines.en: Meat? I do not eat that; I eat vegetables.

lines.zh: 你举着食物，我的牙齿不感兴趣。
lines.en: You hold up food, but my teeth are uninterested.

lines.zh: 胡萝卜只会被塞进我的口袋。
lines.en: A carrot only ends up shoved into my pocket.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走，不是因为你手里的东西。
lines.en: I follow you, but not because of what you hold.

lines.zh: 铁的味道对我更有吸引力。
lines.en: The smell of iron draws me more than any meal.

lines.zh: 别用面包摇晃，我只想要墙。
lines.en: Stop waving bread; what I want is a wall.

lines.zh: 食物摆得再近，也不如猎物的脉搏。
lines.en: Food placed close still loses to a heartbeat.

lines.zh: 我的胃早就不会叫了。
lines.en: My stomach stopped growling a long time ago.

lines.zh: 你手心那点香气，飘不过我的鼻梁。
lines.en: That scent in your palm never reaches past my nose.

lines.zh: 我往前倾，是因为你在退。
lines.en: I lean forward only because you step back.

lines.zh: 我的肩撞到你，像沙袋撞墙。
lines.en: My shoulder hits you like a sandbag against brick.

lines.zh: 站稳，我撞过来时不会减速。
lines.en: Stand firm; I do not slow down when I charge.

lines.zh: 别推我，我的脚趾还卡在缝里。
lines.en: Do not push me; my toes are still wedged in a crack.

lines.zh: 这一下用了我的整个体重。
lines.en: That one carried the whole weight of my body.

lines.zh: 你撞得动我，是因为我正想让你撞。
lines.en: You can move me because I allowed the hit.

lines.zh: 四点护甲替我吃掉了大部分冲击。
lines.en: Four points of armor swallowed most of that impact.

lines.zh: 靠太近了，我讨厌柔软的接触。
lines.en: Too close; I dislike soft contact of any kind.

lines.zh: 我的肋骨咯咯响，但没有断。
lines.en: My ribs rattle, though nothing has broken yet.

lines.zh: 石头撞石头，通常石头赢。
lines.en: Stone against stone, and stone usually wins.

lines.zh: 你再顶我，我就顺着你爬上去。
lines.en: Push me again and I will climb straight up you.

lines.zh: 我们这一族不需要那样的热闹。
lines.en: My kind has no need for that kind of revelry.

lines.zh: 我只会和峭壁亲近。
lines.en: The only thing I get close to is a cliff.

lines.zh: 你找错对象了，我只想往上爬。
lines.en: Wrong target; I only want to keep climbing.

lines.zh: 繁殖？我连自己的手指都数不清。
lines.en: Breed? I cannot even count my own fingers.

lines.zh: 尘土和碎石是我的伴侣。
lines.en: Dust and broken stone are the company I keep.

lines.zh: 别靠在我身边，我要去高处。
lines.en: Do not nestle against me; I belong up high.

lines.zh: 我的族群只在黑暗里交换眼神。
lines.en: My kin exchange only glances, and only in the dark.

lines.zh: 那种事留给还活着的生物吧。
lines.en: Leave that business to creatures still truly alive.

lines.zh: 两只僵尸靠在一起也还是冷的。
lines.en: Two zombies leaning together stay just as cold.

lines.zh: 我唯一想厮守的是这面石墙。
lines.en: The only thing I want to cling to is this wall.

lines.zh: 铁锭掉在地上，我就顺手收了。
lines.en: An iron ingot drops, and I simply take it.

lines.zh: 我的手指能捡起很小的东西。
lines.en: My fingers can pick up very small things.

lines.zh: 这半根胡萝卜归我了。
lines.en: This half carrot belongs to me now.

lines.zh: 我弯腰很慢，但从不失手。
lines.en: I bend down slowly, yet I never miss.

lines.zh: 掉落的土豆滚到我脚边，正好。
lines.en: A fallen potato rolls to my feet; convenient.

lines.zh: 我把东西塞进破旧的衣兜。
lines.en: I stuff the thing into my torn coat pocket.

lines.zh: 捡东西时我仍然看着你。
lines.en: Even while picking things up, I keep watching you.

lines.zh: 这块铁比昨天的更亮。
lines.en: This piece of iron shines brighter than yesterday's.

lines.zh: 我不需要它，但收集让我安心。
lines.en: I do not need it, but collecting puts me at ease.

lines.zh: 地上留下的东西，都算我的。
lines.en: Whatever is left on the ground is mine.

lines.zh: 我闻到你，也看到了能抓的地方。
lines.en: I catch your scent and spot something to grab.

lines.zh: 你站在那儿，正好在我的路线里。
lines.en: You stand there, right along my climbing line.

lines.zh: 目标锁定：你，还有你身后的墙。
lines.en: Target acquired: you, and the wall behind you.

lines.zh: 我看见你的影子，比你先到。
lines.en: I see your shadow, and it reaches me before you.

lines.zh: 你刚才那声脚步，替我指了路。
lines.en: That footstep you made just showed me the way.

lines.zh: 我开始往上爬，而不是往前。
lines.en: I begin climbing upward, not moving forward.

lines.zh: 你逃跑的方向有一面峭壁，真好。
lines.en: Your escape route has a cliff in it; how kind.

lines.zh: 我的手先动，眼睛随后才确认。
lines.en: My hands move first; my eyes confirm afterward.

lines.zh: 别躲进洞里，那是我最熟悉的地方。
lines.en: Do not hide in a cave; that is my favorite place.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸声盖过了石头的风声。
lines.en: Your breathing drowns out the wind over stone.

lines.zh: 我找到了你的脖子，也是我的捷径。
lines.en: I have found your neck, and it is my shortcut.

lines.zh: 高处的视野很好，你也看得见。
lines.en: The view from up here is fine, and you are in it.

lines.zh: 我数到三就下来，别急着走。
lines.en: I will come down on three, so do not hurry off.

lines.zh: 这次我不靠墙，直接扑过去。
lines.en: This time I skip the wall and simply lunge.

lines.zh: 你身后的岩壁，我已经摸过了。
lines.en: I have already tested the cliff behind you.

lines.zh: 我一直盯着你，脖子都没转。
lines.en: I have not turned my neck once, and you are still watched.

lines.zh: 你的每一步都在我的计算里。
lines.en: Every step you take is already in my count.

lines.zh: 别回头，我不喜欢被看见犹豫。
lines.en: Do not look back; hesitation annoys me greatly.

lines.zh: 我在等你走到墙根，那里最好下手。
lines.en: I wait for you to reach the wall; best place to strike.

lines.zh: 你换了方向，我也挪了半步。
lines.en: You changed direction, so I shifted half a step.

lines.zh: 我的目光顺着你的脚踝往上。
lines.en: My gaze travels up from your ankles, slowly.

lines.zh: 你举起盾，我改看你的小腿。
lines.en: You raise a shield, so I study your calves instead.

lines.zh: 我听见你的心跳在加速。
lines.en: I hear your heartbeat picking up its pace.

lines.zh: 我们之间只隔着一小段空气。
lines.en: Only a short stretch of air lies between us.

lines.zh: 你越往角落走，我越满意。
lines.en: The closer you walk to the corner, the happier I get.

lines.zh: 我不急，反正你不会比墙更快。
lines.en: No rush; you cannot outrun a wall anyway.

lines.zh: 我的手指在石面上敲了三下。
lines.en: My fingers tap the stone three times, waiting.

lines.zh: 你身后的出口，我早就记住了。
lines.en: I memorized the exit behind you long ago.

lines.zh: 别停下喘气，那样太明显了。
lines.en: Do not stop to catch your breath; it shows.

lines.zh: 我往下看，先估了高度。
lines.en: I look down and judge the height first.

lines.zh: 你走到开阔地，我反而更慢。
lines.en: You reach open ground, and I deliberately slow.

lines.zh: 我攀着凸起，一格一格跟着。
lines.en: I climb the holds, following ledge by ledge.

lines.zh: 你的火把照不到头顶，我知道。
lines.en: Your torch does not reach overhead. I know.

lines.zh: 这一爪从上面落下来，很重。
lines.en: This claw comes down from above, and it is heavy.

lines.zh: 我的指节刮过你的锁骨。
lines.en: My knuckles scrape across your collarbone.

lines.zh: 你挡得住手，挡不住脚。
lines.en: You can block my hand but not my foot.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的衣领，往下拽。
lines.en: I grab your collar and drag you downward.

lines.zh: 石头磨过我的爪子，比我更硬。
lines.en: Stone has worn my claws harder than yours.

lines.zh: 你退了一步，我的第二下已经在路上。
lines.en: You step back, and my second swing is already coming.

lines.zh: 我打你，是因为你比岩石更软。
lines.en: I hit you because you are softer than rock.

lines.zh: 手臂抡圆了，这一下不轻。
lines.en: My arm swings full circle; this one lands hard.

lines.zh: 你流汗了，这让抓握更容易。
lines.en: You are sweating, which makes you easier to grip.

lines.zh: 我的护甲替你省了痛，可惜不够。
lines.en: Your armor spares you some pain, but not enough.

lines.zh: 我踢中的地方，你三天都会记得。
lines.en: Where my boot lands, you will remember for days.

lines.zh: 别用手接，我的骨头是石头做的。
lines.en: Do not block with your hand; my bones are stone.

lines.zh: 一击不够，我从来不只来一次。
lines.en: One blow is never enough; I always return.

lines.zh: 你倒下时，我会先看看墙。
lines.en: When you fall, I will check the wall first.

lines.zh: 我从上方落下，砸在你肩上。
lines.en: I drop from above and land on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一拳打在护甲的缝上。
lines.en: This fist lands in the seam of your armour.

lines.zh: 黑暗够了，我就从石缝里出来了。
lines.en: The dark was sufficient, so I crawled out of a crack.

lines.zh: 我从阴影里站起，膝盖先响。
lines.en: I rise from the shadow, knees cracking first.

lines.zh: 这个洞穴很适合我，谢谢你留灯。
lines.en: This cave suits me; thank you for leaving it dark.

lines.zh: 我醒来时手指已经抠进岩壁。
lines.en: I woke with my fingers already dug into the wall.

lines.zh: 上面的世界太亮了，我眯着眼。
lines.en: The world above is too bright; I squint at it.

lines.zh: 我从天花板垂下来，别抬头。
lines.en: I drop from the ceiling, so do not look up.

lines.zh: 生成在这里，是因为这里够黑。
lines.en: I spawned here because here is dark enough.

lines.zh: 二十点生命，够我爬很久。
lines.en: Twenty health is plenty for a long climb.

lines.zh: 我落地时没有声音，只有碎石。
lines.en: I land silently, apart from a little gravel.

lines.zh: 又一个夜晚，又一次从墙壁开始。
lines.en: Another night, another beginning on a wall.

lines.zh: 我把头扭正，骨头咔了一声。
lines.en: I straighten my head with a single sharp crack.

lines.zh: 这块岩壁我记得，我回来过。
lines.en: I remember this rock face; I have been here before.

lines.zh: 有人忘了插火把，我就来了。
lines.en: Someone forgot a torch, so here I am.

lines.zh: 我从土里钻出来，带上铁的味道。
lines.en: I climb out of the dirt smelling of iron.

lines.zh: 火烧着我的皮，像干草一样。
lines.en: Fire eats my hide like dry straw in a field.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下来了，这不常发生。
lines.en: I fell from a height, which rarely happens.

lines.zh: 水比石壁滑，我抓不住任何东西。
lines.en: Water is slicker than stone; I cannot grip anything.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我从墙上震了下来，真丢脸。
lines.en: The blast knocked me off the wall; humiliating.

lines.zh: 箭钉在肩上，我把它拔了出来。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder, so I pull it out.

lines.zh: 那股魔法让我的关节发僵。
lines.en: That magic stiffens every joint in my body.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西很久了，胃已经安静。
lines.en: I stopped eating long ago; my stomach is quiet.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的骨头都在发光。
lines.en: Lightning strikes, and my bones glow from inside.

lines.zh: 这里没有墙，我什么都抓不到。
lines.en: There is no wall here, nothing to catch hold of.
